Good, now I need to add the dependencies for text encoding conversions and Unicode normalization. The key packages are:
- `golang.org/x/text/encoding` - for character encoding conversions (UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, Windows-1252, etc.)
- `golang.org/x/text/encoding/ianaindex` - for IANA encoding names
- `golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm` - for Unicode normalization (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD)
- `golang.org/x/text/transform` - for streaming transformations
